items.review_rationale: Read pushforward measure for two measurable spaces and a measurable map, using nonnegative sigma-additive measure and preimage under the map; no density or bijectivity assumed.

references.context: A function whose preimage of every target measurable set B in Tau lies in domain sigma algebra Sigma.
Subset of X consisting of all x such that f(x) belongs to measurable B subset Y.
Assigns to each B in target sigma algebra Tau the source measure of its inverse image.

references.disposition: Pushforward measure is defined for any appropriately measurable mapping, not just coordinate changes.

items.review_rationale: Read arbitrary-set partition as nonempty blocks whose union is S and whose distinct blocks are pairwise disjoint; empty S can admit an empty family of blocks.

references.context: Each block B in family P contains at least one element and lies within ambient S.

references.phrase: union of blocks is all S
references.context: Covering condition every s in S belongs to at least one B in P.
Distinct blocks B,C of P have empty intersection.
Family of subsets of S, possibly empty when S is empty.

references.disposition: Base set and number of blocks are arbitrary; disjointness and covering are jointly required.

items.review_rationale: Read unique-block membership characterization for each s in S, separating existence and uniqueness and noting nonempty blocks, without creating self-edge to the first formulation.

references.context: All members B of family P are nonempty subsets of S.

references.phrase: unique containing block for each s
references.context: For every s in S exists exactly one member B of P for which s belongs to B.
Collection of subsets of S representing all blocks of the partition.

references.disposition: Unique-block membership is equivalent to the union and pairwise-disjointness formulation of the same contextual meaning.

items.review_rationale: Read fraction-field construction as equivalence classes of numerator/denominator pairs over an integral domain, denominators nonzero, with cross-multiplication relation and induced field arithmetic.

references.context: Relation on pairs with nonzero denominators, identifying fractions with the same value.
Restriction to denominator b not equal to zero of D.
Addition and multiplication defined using pair representations and proved independent of representative.
Injective unital ring homomorphism sending a in D to its class a/1.

references.disposition: This is a universal fraction-field construction for any integral domain, not the special rational-number fraction field.
